commands: cat sonar-project.properties 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^sonar.projectKey' || echo "No projectKey in sonar-project.properties"

cat > /tmp/check_ci_qg.py << 'EOF'
import subprocess
import json
import sys

result = subprocess.run(
    [
        "mcp", "call",
        "sonarqube/mcp__sonarqube__get_project_quality_gate_status",
        json.dumps({
            "projectKey": "demo-app",
            "server": "work"
        })
    ],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True
)

print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
print("Exit code:", result.returncode, file=sys.stderr)
EOF
python3 /tmp/check_ci_qg.py 2>&1
